attempted_claim: Let {G_q} be the named LPS Ramanujan family (fixed prime p, varying quotient q) restricted to graphs with 120 <= |V(G_q)| <= 520, and let J(G_q) be the squarefree cover ideal in k[V(G_q)]. Then rho(J(G_q)) <= 1.35 for every graph in this window, proved via a spectral-gap lower bound hat-alpha(J(G_q)) >= f(lambda2) plus a cited Harbourne-Huneke-type containment lemma, with the 120-vertex member fully worked as extremal witness.
